definitions.explanation: A mathematical value; a count or amount.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}の{数|すう}が{増|ふ}えた。
{偶数|ぐうすう}と{奇数|きすう}に{分|わ}ける。
examples.english: Divide into even and odd numbers.

notes:
{数|すう} is used both independently and as a component in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数|すう}が{増|ふ}える/{減|へ}る (number increases/decreases)
- {数|すう}を{数|かぞ}える (to count numbers)
- {数|すう}{十|じゅう} (tens, dozens)
- {数|すう}{百|ひゃく} (hundreds)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {人数|にんずう} (number of people)
- {数字|すうじ} (numeral, digit)
- {数学|すうがく} (mathematics)
- {偶数|ぐうすう} (even number)
- {奇数|きすう} (odd number)
- {多数|たすう} (large number, majority)
- {少数|しょうすう} (small number, minority)

READING NOTE:
{数|すう} is the on'yomi reading used in compounds. The kun'yomi is {数|かず}.
